page.notes: The Greek in the first paragraph (εὐχαριστία) and in the quotation "Ecclesiasticae εὐταξίας" and "καταχοσμησικῶς" is only approximately legible on the scan; these readings are doubtful. The Greek phrase τὴν τῶν ἱεραρχῶν τάξιν is also uncertain in its accents. The marginal note is printed in a small italic-like face and is copied as seen.
